pages.text: The $(item)Iesnium Anvil$() is a $(#AA00AA)Marid$() infusion.$(br)This anvil has some improvements:$(br)1. Is unbreakable;$(br)2. Can exceed the maximum level of enchantments by 1;$(br)3. Marid will pay half of the showed level cost (round up);$()
$(br)4. The cost increase of working with the same item is reduced;$(br)5. The maximum cost limit is increased;$(br)
